title: GingivitisSeg: A Public Dataset and Comparative Benchmark for Gingivitis Segmentation in Intraoral Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.15184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gingivitis segmentation from intraoral photographs can support computer-assisted periodontal assessment, but pixel-level delineation remains challenging due to severe foreground-background class imbalance, low-contrast boundaries, and variations in illumination and anatomy. We introduce GingivitisSeg, a public benchmark comprising 961 intraoral images with pixel-level annotations of gingival inflammation and predefined training (672), validation (144), and test (145) partitions. Seven semantic segmentation model-backbone configurations were compared using standardized partitions, input resolution, and evaluation metrics. Controlled ablation experiments examined class-weighted cross-entropy loss, Dice loss, and auxiliary supervision. UPerNet with ResNet50 achieved the highest mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 76.49% and gingivitis IoU of 54.91%. translated_title: GingivitisSeg：用于口内图像牙龈炎分割的公开数据集与对比基准
translated_abstract: 从口内照片中进行牙龈炎分割可以支持计算机辅助牙周评估，但由于前景与背景类别严重不平衡、边界对比度低以及光照和解剖结构的变化，像素级 delineation 仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了GingivitisSeg，这是一个公开基准数据集，包含961张带有牙龈炎症像素级标注的口内图像，并预先定义了训练集（672张）、验证集（144张）和测试集（145张）的划分。在标准化的数据划分、输入分辨率和评估指标下，我们比较了七种语义分割模型-骨干网络配置。受控消融实验检验了类别加权交叉熵损失、Dice损失和辅助监督的效果。采用ResNet50骨干的UPerNet取得了最高的平均交并比（mIoU）76.49%，牙龈炎IoU达到54.91%。然而，其与采用ResNet50的DeepLabV3+以及采用MiT-B2的SegFormer之间的差异并不显著。
tldr: 该论文发布了首个用于口内图像牙龈炎像素级分割的公开标注数据集GingivitisSeg（含961张图像及标准化划分），并通过系统基准测试发现UPerNet+ResNet50以76.49%的mIoU取得最佳分割性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GingivitisSeg, a publicly available pixel-level annotated dataset of 961 intraoral images for gingivitis segmentation with standardized splits, and shows through systematic benchmarking that UPerNet with ResNet50 achieves the best performance with 76.49% mIoU.
